title: ICT Manager
description:
Summary
To manage the ICT department by leading project delivery, ensuring infrastructure stability, protecting information assets, and driving team performance in line with business goals.
Duties and Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end planning and execution of ICT projects.
Plan and ensure project delivery is on time and within budget.
Coordinate with stakeholders to gather requirements and define technical solutions.
Oversee system implementation, integration, infrastructure setup, and ERP deployments.
Monitor ICT infrastructure to ensure high availability and minimal downtime.
Train, manage, and coach the ICT team to meet project goals and timelines.
Assess team performance, track KPIs, and drive continuous improvement.
Enforce confidentiality, non-disclosure, and data protection policies.
Ensure compliance with ICT standards, security protocols, and backup procedures.
Manage vendor relationships, procurement, and system documentation.
Oversee user training, technical support, and post-implementation follow-up.
Job Requirements
Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in ICT management or project leadership.
Proven experience in infrastructure operations, system implementation, and team management.
Strong knowledge of ERP systems, networking, and cybersecurity.
Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Others
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Project/Service delivery success rate (on time, within budget)
System uptime and incident response time
Team performance and development metrics
Compliance with data security and confidentiality policies
Stakeholder and end-user satisfaction
Required to travel from site to site
